name: Heat Fortitude
text:
**Heat Fortitude** (race trait; Kobold)

You grew up close to sulfurous volcanic vents, which steeled you against heat dangers. You gain a +4 trait bonus on Fortitude saving throws against nonlethal damage from heat.
